answer.reason: The verses state what the throne was made of and how it was adorned, which the summary only names in part.

clauses.english: was made of ivory and overlaid with the best gold
clauses.quote: made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the best gold

clauses.english: had six steps with twelve lions standing on them, unmatched in any kingdom
clauses.quote: there was not the like made in any kingdom

doubts: The summary already mentions ivory, gold, six steps and twelve lions, so the clauses mostly restate it; they add only the best gold overlay and that nothing like it was made in any kingdom.
